_note: agenda-incoming-documents-list (age-13): an agenda item type says whether its items are incoming documents. The meeting's Incoming documents widget and the Incoming documents page read agenda items of a flagged type, instead of the retired raadsinformatiebrief and ingekomen-stuk schemas.

incomingDocument.title: Incoming document
incomingDocument.description: Items of this kind are incoming letters or documents: they wait on the Incoming documents list until they are put on a meeting's agenda.
